children.name: Card Header
texts: Deliver server health and backup/restore events to Discord, Slack, ntfy, email, or webhooks. Credentials are entered when adding a sink and stored as a labelled Secret in the control-plane namespace.

children.name: fieldSinkName
texts: A short lowercase identifier (letters, digits, and dashes) used to name the sink and its Secret — like team-alerts.

children.name: fieldSinkLanguage Hint
children.text: Notifications sent to this sink are written in this language.
